info.title: Otacon Phone Automation API
info.description: REST API for controlling Android phones connected to a Raspberry Pi.

200.description: PNG image of the current phone screen

version_name.description:
Human versionName (e.g. "9.27.0"). Only populated when explicitly requested
(uses `dumpsys package <pkg>` per-app, which is slow).

adapter_mac.description: Assigned BT dongle MAC on the host

bt_connected.description: Whether the phone is currently BT-connected to its assigned dongle

imei2.description: IMEI for second SIM slot (dual-SIM devices)

monitor.description: Fleet-agent monitor status (setup progress, health, heals)

phone_bt_mac.description: Phone's BT MAC (if known from pairing)

screen_state.description:
Current screen state — agents should check this before issuing
per-phone actions like screenshot/tap/etc.
Values: "unlocked", "locked", "asleep", "dozing", "dreaming", "unknown"

vnc_port.description:
VNC port on the host that proxies this phone's screen
(connect with vnc://{host_address}:{vnc_port})

enabled.description: Currently active on a SIM slot (slot >= 0 && apps enabled)

historical.description: True for stale physical SIM records (only present when ?all=true)

status.description:
Status string: "active" (enabled, on a slot), "disabled" (installed
but not active), or "historical" (stale subscription record from a
previously-inserted physical SIM, only shown with ?all=true)

key.description: Key name (home, back, enter, power, etc.) or raw keycode number

cpu_pct.description: Approximate CPU usage percent across all cores (0-100, normalized)

apps.description: List of running/foreground apps (empty when phone is asleep)

screen_state.description:
Current screen state — explains an empty `apps` list
(asleep/dozing/dreaming → can't enumerate; unlocked → genuinely no apps)
See /api/info screen_state docs for the full enum.

ref.description: Element ref ID (must be an EditText)

max_duration.description: Max recording duration in seconds (default 300, max 600)

ref.description: Element ref ID (if tapping by ref, e.g. "e5")

text.description: Text to type (ASCII only, via ADB input)

desired_enabled.description: Persisted host-local desired state for this phone.
